project_type: SA-MP Android Lua scripts for MonetLoader (game modification framework)
build_system: No build system - Lua scripts loaded directly by MonetLoader on Android device
test_framework: No automated tests - tested on device. Scripts use pcall for error handling.
build_command: N/A - Lua scripts are interpreted at runtime on Android
verification_instructions: Verify files have valid Lua syntax using luac or luajit -bl. Check that require paths match actual file locations.
setup_instructions: Copy .lua files to MonetLoader scripts folder on Android device
environment_constraints: Cannot run on host - targets Android with GTA SA + MonetLoader. Verification limited to syntax checks and structural correctness.
contribution_requirements: Commit messages use format: type: description. Types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore. Code should be readable with clear variable names (camelCase), proper error handling, and comments for complex logic.

key_patterns.script_structure: script_name() + script_author() at top, require imports, config via jsoncfg, imgui.OnFrame for UI, main() function with while true loop
key_patterns.imgui_usage: imgui.OnFrame(condition_fn, render_fn), imgui.ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(imgui.ImVec4(r,g,b,a)) for colors, PushStyleVarFloat/PushStyleVarVec2 for styling, Button not Checkbox for toggles, window flags combined with +
key_patterns.jni_bridge: require('android') returns JNI table with findClass, callVoidMethod, callObjectMethod, callStaticObjectMethod, to_javastring, to_luastring, looperPrepare, showToast, context2, activityClassloader, checkForJNIException
key_patterns.jni_internals: getActivity() via gta._Z27NVEventGetPlatformAppHandlev(), getJNIEnv() via gta._Z24NVThreadGetCurrentJNIEnvv(), env[0] contains all JNI function pointers including NewObject, NewGlobalRef, DeleteGlobalRef, GetMethodID, FindClass etc.
key_patterns.lib_require_pattern: Libraries in lib/ folder required as require('lib.modulename') e.g. require('lib.vehiclehud_lib'). Subdirs use dot notation: require('lib.webviews.init')
key_patterns.dpi_scaling: MONET_DPI_SCALE global available for scaling UI elements
key_patterns.no_pcall_in_render: Never use pcall inside imgui.OnFrame render callback

directory_structure: Root contains .lua scripts (main scripts), lib/ contains library modules, MonetLoader-lib-full/ contains the MonetLoader framework libraries (android.lua, jsoncfg.lua, mimgui, etc.), testing/ contains test scripts
